data.title: Improve Usability and Accessibility
data.outcome: Help more people understand and complete key tasks with a mouse, keyboard, and assistive technology.
intentExamples: Make the site usable with a keyboard
My website is hard to use

stages.title: Use structure that clearly expresses page hierarchy
stages.action: Check heading order, regions, and content groups.
stages.evidence: The page structure is understandable even without visual styling.

lessons.title: HTML
lessons.tagline: Describe the structure and meaning of a web page

lessons.title: Typography
lessons.tagline: Use text size and style to show what matters first

lessons.title: Divider
lessons.tagline: Use a line to separate two different groups of content

stages.title: Give every control a clear name
stages.action: Add form labels, button text, and meaningful link descriptions.
stages.evidence: People can understand what controls do with a screen reader or from text alone.

lessons.title: Label
lessons.tagline: Visible text that tells people what a form control asks for

lessons.title: Button
lessons.tagline: Click to save, submit, delete, or run another action

lessons.title: Link
lessons.tagline: Click to open another page, location, or file

stages.title: Support the main flow with a keyboard alone
stages.action: Check tab order, visible focus, and modal focus behavior.
stages.evidence: Users can enter, operate, and exit the main flow without a mouse.

lessons.title: Focus
lessons.tagline: Show which element will receive keyboard input

lessons.title: Skip Link
lessons.tagline: A link that lets keyboard users skip repeated navigation and move to the main content

lessons.title: Modal
lessons.tagline: Pause the page for one focused decision or task

stages.title: Do not communicate states with color alone
stages.action: Add text or shape cues for errors, disabled controls, selections, and success.
stages.evidence: Different states remain distinguishable with low contrast or no color.

lessons.title: Alert
lessons.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page

lessons.title: Disabled
lessons.tagline: Show that a control is currently unavailable

lessons.title: Selection
lessons.tagline: Show which text or items the user has selected
